inputs.text: Cinematic 3D render, film still, ultra-wide 2.4:1, sleek stylized dark science fiction, minimal and elegant, matte black and glossy black surfaces, crisp white glowing light, deep shadows, very low-key. A dark circular control hall with a glossy black floor and curved walls of monitors showing small white and cyan metric graphs and meters. In the middle of the hall, levitating in mid-air, hangs the Helm: a large black hexagonal prism, a monolith, whose surface is divided into hexagonal panels glowing white along their edges, slowly turning. A single column of white light passes through it from the floor to the ceiling, brighter above and below the object. Crew in matching dark grey-olive coveralls with a yellow stripe on the shoulders sit at slim consoles around the room, seen from behind in shadow. In the foreground, seen from behind and small against the object, stand a slender woman with short slicked-back blonde hair in a light grey uniform with yellow stripes on the shoulders, and a tall man in a long dark coat. Strictly no visible faces, no text, no logos, not a cartoon, not gothic, not steampunk, not retro.
